I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-team message. I noted that the signed order form for Tansley Parcel is due 25 August, and asked her to confirm the date. Today is 14 October, so she may mean 25 August next year, or a deadline that has already passed.

I took no other action. The deadline is a signing date, not a finance figure, so it's fine to keep in the channel.
